claims.description: Forward migration 0153 drops only the answer-event foreign key while retaining the UUID column and both partial unique indexes; prior migrations remain immutable.
The Drizzle schema retains answerEventId as a scalar while profile and source-session ownership continues to cascade notices.
Real-database purge coverage proves transcript events are deleted while notices survive with their original answerEventId values.
The public envelope accepts an omitted learnerQuote while retaining required answerEventId and non-empty validation for a present quote.
Downstream evidence validation still checks event existence, user-message type, learner/session ownership, and quote overlap only when the optional quote is present.
The write boundary rejects fresh notices without answerEventId while legacy nullable rows remain readable.
Rollback documentation permits restoring the foreign key only when no dangling evidence identifiers exist and forbids identity loss to force the constraint.
Focused schema regression and existing real-database coverage preserve the complete red-green variant matrix and migration immutability contract.
